items.question: How do I open a trading account?
items.answer: Fill in the registration form (2 minutes), confirm your email and complete verification in the client area by uploading an identity document. After approval — usually within one business day — the account is ready for funding.

items.question: What is the minimum deposit?
items.answer: From $100 on the Standard account. For Pro and ECN Prime the minimum deposit is $1,000 and $5,000 respectively. The demo account is free and requires no funding.

items.question: Is there a demo account and how does it differ from a live one?
items.answer: Yes — a demo account with virtual $10,000 is available right after registration. Quotes, spreads and execution fully replicate live conditions; only the source of funds differs.

items.question: Do I need to pass verification (KYC)?
items.answer: Yes, verification is required by the regulator: you will need an identity document and proof of address. It protects your account from unauthorized access and third-party withdrawals.

items.question: What leverage is available?
items.answer: Up to 1:500 on Standard, up to 1:400 on Pro and up to 1:200 on ECN Prime. You can lower the leverage in your dashboard settings — many experienced traders deliberately work with 1:50 or less.

items.question: What is negative balance protection?
items.answer: A guarantee that you will never lose more than you deposited. Even with a sharp gap against your position, any negative balance is reset to zero at the company’s expense.

items.question: When can I trade?
items.answer: Forex, indices and metals trade around the clock from Monday to Friday. Crypto — 24/7 with no days off. Stocks — during the corresponding exchange sessions.

items.question: Are scalping and expert advisors allowed?
items.answer: Yes, without restrictions: scalping, automated strategies and hedging are allowed on all account types. Execution from 14 ms suits high-frequency strategies.

items.question: How do I fund my account and how long does it take?
items.answer: Bank cards, wire transfer, e-wallets and crypto. Cards and wallets are credited instantly; wire transfers take 1–3 business days. Deposit fee — 0%.

items.question: How long do withdrawals take?
items.answer: 92% of requests are processed automatically within minutes. The rest go through manual review and are completed within 24 hours. Withdrawals are only possible via the same method used for funding.

items.question: Where are client funds held?
items.answer: In segregated accounts with Tier-1 banks, separate from the company’s operating funds. This is a regulatory requirement: client funds cannot be used in the broker’s business activities.
